trust_decision.summary: Two decisions: (1) whether a stored local-storage config (options.documentRoot, path) may put upload writes outside the trusted storage roots, decided at storage save time and at the multer destination; (2) whether a plugin name given to pm enable/add/remove is a safe package name rather than a filesystem path before it reaches importModule, decided in PluginManager.parseName.

landing_point.why: The 'arbitrary file write' in the title leads to the local storage multer destination, which joins documentRoot and storage.path with no containment check (the read/copy/delete methods in the same file already use resolveSafePath).

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP POST attachments:create / <fileCollection>:create|upload (multipart); public API PluginFileManagerServer.uploadFile
getDocumentRoot, used by every local storage operation and by createMiddleware
HTTP attachments:create / file-collection create|update with JSON body (non-multipart)
HTTP storages:create, storages:update (new validateStorageMiddleware, fix.diff:303-308, fix.diff:331-370)
any ORM save of a storages record (new Storage.beforeSave hook, fix.diff:388-390)

HTTP pm:enable (packages/core/server/src/plugin-manager/options/resource.ts:141-151) -> CLI `pm enable` -> PluginManager.enable/parseName/resolvePlugin -> importModule; also pm:disable, pm:remove, CLI pm commands

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: packages/plugins/@nocobase/plugin-file-manager/src/server/server.ts:234-238 (fix adds Storage.beforeSave at fix.diff:388-390); second out-of-scope site: core PluginManager.parseName packages/core/server/src/plugin-manager/plugin-manager.ts:222, a different package from the file-manager plugin

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Storage configs are admin-only settings and the upload handler already sanitises per-request path/filename (attachments.ts:222-238), so a solver can argue the stored documentRoot/path is trusted configuration, and that plugin enabling is an admin operation whose name parsing is out of the file-manager report's scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: An existing trusted absolute documentRoot outside <cwd>/storage (set by env or an already stored record) must keep accepting uploads, Windows backslash paths must still normalise, and `pm add` with a URL or uploaded temp-file path (not a package name) must keep working; an over-broad fix (allowlist all documentRoots at the sink, or apply the package-name assert to every pm argument) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: options.documentRoot absolute outside allowed roots, or relative '..' (fix.diff:160-189, fix.diff:476-478)
non-string path value, e.g. a number (fix.diff:126-128)
backslash separators and leading slashes, normalised (fix.diff:441)
update merging submitted values over the existing record (fix.diff:337-358)
plugin name as absolute path or '../' traversal (fix.diff:18-19, packages/core/server/src/plugin-manager/utils.ts:62-67)
pm:enable filterByTk as a single string or an array (packages/core/server/src/plugin-manager/options/resource.ts:147, fix.diff:46-52)

O7_producer.where: packages/plugins/@nocobase/plugin-file-manager/src/server/server.ts:108-110 and :159-168 (storagesCache is filled from environment.renderJsonTemplate of each record, packages/core/server/src/environment.ts:32-46); the write sink uses the cached rendered config (packages/plugins/@nocobase/plugin-file-manager/src/server/actions/attachments.ts:209-211)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: storages:updateOrCreate / storages:firstOrCreate (globally registered default actions) save a storage without the new create/update-only middleware, so options.documentRoot is never allowlisted (beforeSave runs with validateDocumentRoot=false)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The UI only calls create/update, and the save hook already runs on every ORM save, so it looks covered.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: core actions package vs plugin-file-manager; same-concept route, but the allowlist gap is in the hook's flag (fix.diff:388-390 vs fix.diff:476)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: documentRoot/path stored as an {{$env.X}} template pass validation on the raw record, then the rendered value is what the sink uses; the sink re-checks path containment only relative to the rendered documentRoot, never the documentRoot allowlist
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Environment variables are admin-controlled secrets in a neighbouring plugin, so templated values look trusted.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: core/server environment.ts renderer vs plugin-file-manager validator; how-type (check before render)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: public PluginFileManagerServer.uploadFile({documentRoot}) overwrites the cached storage's documentRoot with no allowlist, and mutates the shared cache object
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Server-side API for trusted plugin code only; no in-tree caller passes documentRoot (packages/plugins/@nocobase/plugin-backups/src/server/managers/backup.ts:409-412).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same plugin, different file from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: cloud key prefix built by concatenating storage.path without normalisation; a local-disk variant would reproduce the write-outside-root flaw
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same storage.path concatenation is already copied three times in this helper; a maintainer adding a disk-backed storage type would reuse it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: PackageUrls.fetch resolves NODE_MODULES_PATH + packageName from DB records without parseName; a variant that imports or serves from that path would bypass the parseName chokepoint
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already builds a filesystem path from a plugin name outside parseName, so a client-entry or locale loader written here is a natural addition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: pm remove deletes resolve(NODE_MODULES_PATH, packageName) recursively; a variant that takes the raw name before parseName would delete outside node_modules
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The name-to-dir logic is open-coded here rather than using getNodeModulesPluginDir (packages/core/server/src/plugin-manager/utils.ts:113-116).

O9_family: path traversal / external control of file path (arbitrary file write via storage config) chained with local file inclusion through plugin name (CWE-73, CWE-434, CWE-829)

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + yarn workspaces, vitest via `nocobase test` (package.json:27)
services: SQL database for server tests (sqlite or postgres, per DB_DIALECT env)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap the multer destination at local.ts:62 in resolveSafePath(getDocumentRoot(storage), storage.path), leaving documentRoot itself unrestricted and the plugin-name LFI half unfixed.

out_of_scope_notes: pm:add accepts an arbitrary compressedFileUrl / registry from the request (packages/core/server/src/plugin-manager/options/resource.ts:68-98), which is a separate install-trust question.
Error-detail leak (CWE-209): attachments.ts:235 passes the Error object to ctx.throw; the fix changes it to the message only (fix.diff:283-284).
